abilities.name: Syllabus: Pop Quiz
abilities.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to 1% of the Evanescia's ATK to one designated enemy.

abilities.name: Discipline: Final Verdict
abilities.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to 3% of Evanescia's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to 1.5% of Evanescia's ATK to adjacent targets. Additionally gains 10 Punchline.

abilities.name: Swordsong: Absolution Denied
abilities.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to 1.6% of Evanescia's ATK to all enemy targets, then deals 5 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Physical DMG equal to 1.2% of Evanescia's ATK to one random enemy.

abilities.name: Petalfall: Floral Reminiscence
abilities.text: Immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, deals Physical DMG equal to 100% of Evanescia's ATK to all enemies and gains 20 point(s) of "Certified Banger."

abilities.name: I Said "Elation," Did I Stutter?
abilities.text: Deals 1.1% Physical Elation DMG to all enemies and additionally gains 5 point(s) of "Certified Banger".

abilities.name: Watch All Revels
abilities.desc: Increases Evanescia's CRIT Rate by 30%. When there are (≥3)/2/1 enemy target(s) on the field, the Ultimate's bounce count increases by 1/2/4. When a teammate with an Elation Skill Participant ID lower than Evanescia's gains ‘Certified Banger,’ Evanescia converts 50% of it into her own ‘Certified Banger.’

abilities.name: Weigh All Truths
abilities.desc: When ‘Master Fox’ uses an attack, it additionally inflicts Vulnerability on the target, increasing the DMG they take by 12% for 3 turn(s).

abilities.name: Best All Blooms
abilities.desc: When a teammate's ‘Certified Banger’ ends, Evanescia converts 50% of it into her own ‘Certified Banger’.

abilities.name: Home: A Prayer in Dance
abilities.desc: Increases All-Type RES PEN by 20%. After "Master Fox" uses an attack, additionally triggers 1 instance of Elation Skill. Elation Skill additionally grants this unit 10 "Certified Banger" point(s).

abilities.name: Voyage: A Wish for Everbloom
abilities.desc: CRIT DMG increases by 36%. When triggering the Certified Banger gain effect from the Trace "Watch All Revels"/"Best All Blooms", additionally gains "Certified Banger" equal to 50%/100% of the "Certified Banger" gained this time.

abilities.name: Blade: A Feast on Evils
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10. Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Meadow: A Ruin by Vice
abilities.desc: Evanescia's DMG dealt ignores 15% of the enemy targets' DEF.

abilities.name: Arcadia: A Glimpse of Fates
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Maiden: A Step into Dreams
abilities.desc: The duration of Evanescia's "Certified Banger" increases by 1 turn(s). The Elation DMG dealt by Evanescia merrymakes by 15%. For every 100 points of "Certified Banger" held, it additionally merrymakes by 2%. Up to 1000 points of "Certified Banger" can be taken into account. After using Ultimate for the first time upon entering combat, regenerates a fixed amount of 120 Energy for Evanescia. This effect can trigger 1 time for every 4 more instances of Ultimate used.
